name: Crisis Support Services of Alameda County
description: Crisis Support Services of Alameda County is the local 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline center, offering 24/7 crisis support by phone, text, and chat, plus therapy and support groups.
fullDescription: Crisis Support Services of Alameda County is the local 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline center, offering 24/7 crisis support by phone, text, and chat, plus therapy and support groups.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 crisis and suicide prevention line (call, text, or chat 988)
- Local Alameda County crisis hotline
- Information and referrals to Alameda County Mobile Crisis Teams
- Therapy for youth, adults, older adults, and families
- Support groups in Oakland and around Alameda County
howToGetIt: Call, text, or chat 988 anytime. Alameda County residents can also call the local crisis hotline at 1-800-309-2131. Free and confidential.
keywords: Crisis Support Services, Alameda County, suicide prevention, 988, crisis line, text, chat, therapy, support groups
